title: APPSolver: Adaptive Patch Partitioning for Point-Wise Ship Flow Prediction on Unstructured Meshes
abstract: arXiv:2608.29355v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large non-uniform point sets make direct attention-based surrogate modeling costly for ship hydrodynamics. We introduce APPSolver, a point-wise flow-prediction framework built around Adaptive Patch Partitioning (APP), a deterministic quadtree representation for fixed two-dimensional horizontal slices extracted from ship CFD simulations. APP assigns finer patches near the hull and coarser patches farther away, downsamples patch contents, and recovers predictions to the full reference point set. translated_title: APPSolver：面向非结构化网格上逐点船舶流动预测的自适应补丁划分方法
translated_abstract: 大规模非均匀点集使得直接采用基于注意力的代理建模来处理船舶水动力学问题代价高昂。我们提出了APPSolver，这是一个逐点流动预测框架，其核心是自适应补丁划分（APP）——一种针对从船舶CFD仿真中提取的固定二维水平切片的确定性四叉树表示。APP在船体附近分配更细的补丁、在远处分配更粗的补丁，对补丁内容进行下采样，并将预测结果恢复至完整的参考点集。在一种修正后的实验协议下——即在数据划分之前构造自然 (t,t+1) 时间对、复用训练集的归一化统计量、并报告三个模型随机种子——学习型分词器比APP-Transformer更加准确，且一个持续性基线在全部三个ShipBench船型上均取得了更低的一步预测MAE。因此，APP所支持的收益在于计算效率，而非普遍的预测优越性：在一个代表性的DTC输入上，APP-Transformer重……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: APPSolver提出基于四叉树的自适应补丁划分（APP）框架，通过在船体附近细分、远处粗化的策略降低船舶CFD逐点流动预测的计算成本，但实验表明其收益主要是计算效率而非预测精度的优越性。
en_tdlr: APPSolver introduces Adaptive Patch Partitioning (APP), a deterministic quadtree framework that reduces the computational cost of point-wise ship flow prediction on unstructured meshes, with experiments showing its benefit is computational efficiency rather than universal predictive superiority.
